_about: The shot list of the three-minute demonstration (docs/submission/demo_script.md): one transaction in seven beats, the refusal first. A step that ran on the public program ids carries the `public` caption, one that ran on staging program ids `staging`, and one that ran in the local simulator `simulator`; `web/upgrades.json` and docs/MANIFEST.md have the live state, read on the day. `kind` is live (it happens while it is recorded) or replay (a run made earlier is shown). `faster` is true when the shot is played faster than it happened. A replay carries the first caption and a faster shot the second, each for the shot's whole length; N is the speed measured when the shot is cut, and it is written into the caption then. Render a storyboard of it with `python scripts/video/render.py <file> --limit 180`. tests/test_site_scripts.py holds this file to the script.

captions.first: Built during the hackathon: everything shown. Older work is listed in docs/DISCLOSURE.md.
captions.replay: Replay of a run recorded earlier
captions.staging: Staging program ids on Solana devnet
captions.public: Public program ids on Solana devnet
captions.bank: Written locally. No bank has taken this file.

shots.shows: the title; then FIRST the judge's refusal of beat two with its reason, held while the number is said; then the issue that is the task, the buyer's funding comment, the order with its price, its acceptance terms and their hash, its deadline and the refund if nothing is accepted, and the supplier who takes it
a pull request that says the tests pass, edits the existing test and leaves the bug; plain CI green; the judge's refusal word for word with its code; payment withheld: the order's balance unchanged
the corrected pull request with the fix and a regression test in a new file; the same check; the verdict accepted
buyer and supplier each rebuilding the same statement from their own ledger, side by side, with the same digest
a token that already paid, sent again and refused by the program; the balance unchanged; the repeated evidence listed as a duplicate: no second payment

the paying transaction and the supplier's balance before and after; the fee read from the chain while recording, never typed; the accounting export of the approved statement and its file; the bank instruction file with its caption if the build has it
a machine with the network off verifying the receipt file alone; docs/MANIFEST.md: each public program id, its build, its hash and its commit; the limits as one line; the front door
